🌍☀️ Elon Musk on the true scale of energy:

"The Earth only receives about half a billionth of the Sun’s energy.  

The Sun is 99.8% of all mass in the solar system… Earth is in the miscellaneous category.  

Earth is like a tiny dust mote in a vast darkness.  

The way to actually scale civilization is to scale power in space."

Mind officially blown.  

We’re not energy-limited — we’re location-limited. Time to build in space. 🚀🔋

OPTIMUS IS TESLA’S MOST IMPORTANT PRODUCT FOR HUMANITY’S FUTURE

Elon Musk has repeatedly said that Optimus will be Tesla’s biggest product ever — bigger than the car business.

Here’s why it matters so much:
•  It will take over dangerous, repetitive, and physically exhausting jobs (mining, construction, factory work, disaster response) so humans don’t have to.
•  It will help solve the global caregiving crisis by assisting the elderly and disabled with daily tasks and companionship.
•  It creates real abundance — when physical labor becomes extremely cheap and scalable, the cost of goods, housing, and services drops dramatically for everyone.
•  Long-term, Optimus becomes the workforce that builds and maintains cities on the Moon and Mars.
This isn’t about replacing humans.
It’s about freeing humans from drudgery so we can focus on creativity, exploration, and meaning.
Elon Musk on Optimus:
“Optimus will be the biggest product ever.”
The age of helpful humanoid robots is no longer science fiction.
It’s already beginning inside Tesla factories — and it’s moving fast.

🚨 Cybertruck just proved it’s one of the safest pickups on the road.
In the latest IIHS pedestrian front crash prevention tests, the Cybertruck avoided every single collision — daytime, nighttime, and from different angles.
It’s also the only pickup truck to earn the highest award: IIHS Top Safety Pick+ for 2026.
Real-world safety that actually protects pedestrians and drivers. Tesla’s Collision Avoidance Assist is doing exactly what it’s supposed to do.
Safety isn’t optional — it’s engineered in. 👏

BREAKING: Tesla's momentum in Europe continues to accelerate.

Tesla registered 28,610 new vehicles in Europe during May, a 107.9% increase compared to the same month last year.

This marks the company's fourth straight month of registration growth.

While the broader European auto market saw modest gains, Tesla's growth rate was nearly 30 times higher.

A strong signal that demand is continuing to build across the region.

SpaceX's Starfall Demo mission is a glimpse into the future of space research. 🚀

Launched aboard Falcon 9, the spacecraft is designed to provide affordable, routine access to microgravity for scientific experiments and in-space manufacturing.

After completing its mission, Starfall demonstrates controlled reentry and recovery with a Pacific Ocean splashdown another step toward making space operations more reusable and accessible.

Audrey Crews, the first woman to receive the implant, used only her thoughts to digitally sign her name in cursive and it closely matches the signature she used before paralysis.

For someone who lost physical control after a devastating accident, this is more than a demo. It's a glimpse of a future where brain-computer interfaces may help restore communication, creativity, and independence
